title: apparule.payouts.recipient_requested
description: common (outbox) -> commerce, on cuelabs.requests. A designer submitted a bank account (pages.md B8). commerce resolves the account name with Paystack, creates the transfer recipient, and answers with a payments.outcome of kind recipient_verified or recipient_failed. The account number travels only by data_ref. Key: designer id.

attempt_id.description: common ignores an outcome for an older attempt.

account_holder.description: The name on the designer's profile, to compare with the resolved account name.
